how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Madras Corporate Relations Officer Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 22-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Corporate Relations Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIT Madras Corporate Relations Officer position is 22nd September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Corporate Relations Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Corporate Relations Officer post will receive a salary of Rs. 1,20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor's in Engineering or a Master's in a relevant field with 10 years of experience, or an M.E/M.Tech with 5 years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Corporate Relations Officer role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting based on the application, followed by a test/interview, and document verification.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Corporate Relations Officer post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Corporate Relations Officer position at IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is online.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Corporate Relations Officer position is contract-based.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Madras located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Madras is located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 600036.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates with a Master's degree apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with a Master's degree in a relevant field with 5 years of experience are eligible, provided they also meet other specified criteria.
